title: Populate the card-level grantId on recovery-checkpoint failure cards
outcome: When a rebind's recovery checkpoint is refused (restart_checkpoint_refused carrying the producer's code) or answered with a receipt for another grant (restart_checkpoint_receipt_mismatch), the hold card names the grant that status reported open, in a structured card-level field, without echoing the received receipt's grant or any capability. Today the card's grantId is null; the grant appears only inside causalFailure.attemptId, the refused request's idempotency key, which an operator must parse.
acceptance: A test shows that for both a refused recovery checkpoint and a receipt naming another grant, the hold card carries the grant status reported open in a structured field (for example grantId), while the receipt's own grant id and every routing or delivery token stay absent from persisted and wire projections (engram_root_causal_value_free.rs's absence checks still pass).
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
